description: Chintu hathi aur Mithu tota ke saath yoga seekhein. Yeh bachon ko exercise aur focus karna sikhata hai.
learning: Yoga postures and deep breathing for toddlers.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: A cute round orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a yellow tummy doing yoga in a sunny green jungle.

scenes.text:
Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Like a bird so very high.
scenes.image_prompt: The orange elephant and green parrot reaching their arms and wings up towards the bright blue jungle sky.

scenes.text:
धीरे धीरे नीचे आएं,
पैर छुएं और मुस्कुराएं।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot bending down to touch their toes in a lush green meadow.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot standing in a yoga pose smiling at each other in the jungle.

scenes.text:
Sit down cross-legged on the floor,
Peace is what we are looking for.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot sitting cross-legged on soft jungle grass meditating peacefully.

scenes.text:
सांस लो लंबी और गहरी,
खुशबू है फूलों की सुनहरी।
scenes.image_prompt: A close up of the cute elephant taking a deep breath near colorful jungle flowers.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The parrot perching on the elephant's head as they both do a calm yoga pose.

scenes.text:
Stand on one leg like a tree,
Strong and happy as can be.
scenes.image_prompt: The orange elephant balancing on one leg while the green parrot balances on a nearby branch.

scenes.text:
पंख फैलाओ जैसे तोता,
सबका मन है बड़ा होता।
scenes.image_prompt: The parrot flapping its wings joyfully while the elephant mimics the pose with its ears.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot laughing while doing yoga poses in the sunlight.

scenes.text:
Twist your waist from side to side,
With your friends open and wide.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot twisting their bodies playfully in a forest clearing.

scenes.text:
हिलो डुलों और खुश हो जाओ,
योग का मज़ा सब पाओ।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant wiggling its blue scarf while the parrot dances in circles.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot high-fiving (or wing-trunk touching) after their yoga session.

scenes.text:
Make a circle with your hand,
Best friends across the land.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant making a circle with its trunk and the parrot making a heart shape with wings.

scenes.text:
आंखें बंद करो अब प्यारे,
चमके जैसे नभ के तारे।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot sitting with eyes closed peacefully as fireflies glow around them.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot resting together under a large jungle tree.

scenes.text:
Breathe in slow, breathe out fast,
Yoga fun is built to last.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot showing breathing techniques with cute icons above their heads.

scenes.text:
हाथ जोड़कर बोलो नमस्ते,
हम तो चलते हंसते-हंसते।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant with hands joined in a Namaste and the parrot bowing its head.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot waving goodbye to the camera in the beautiful green jungle.

scenes.text:
Move your body, shake it free,
Just like a happy bumblebee.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant wiggling its round tummy while the parrot zips around like a bee.

scenes.text:
एक-दो-तीन, योग है शान,
बढ़ती है इससे अपनी जान।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant counting with its trunk fingers while the parrot watches.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot doing a group yoga pose together on a soft grassy patch.

scenes.text:
Reach for stars, touch the ground,
Yoga joy is all around.
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant looking up at the sky and then down at the ground with a smile.

scenes.text:
प्यारे साथी, प्यारे यार,
योग से बढ़ता अपना प्यार।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot hugging in the jungle sun.

scenes.text:
हाथी और तोता करें योग,
खुश रहें सब लोग।
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot standing tall and proud in their yoga pose.

scenes.text:
Stretch and bend, wiggle and play,
Have a super yoga day!
scenes.image_prompt: The elephant and parrot playing in the jungle with yoga balls.
